verdict.rationale: Issue triage is a fair question for a GitHub-integrated coding agent, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows a user manually applying a 'jules' label to assign Jules a coding task, plus a general API that developers could use to build custom workflows. Nothing documents automatic triage, severity suggestion, or routing issues to the right owner.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
